response.sql: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total) AS avg_total, SUM(l.cnt) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total - avg_t.a) AS avg_excess FROM line l, avg_t WHERE l.total > avg_t.a
